Comment: The question's premise is the NHBE culture comparison but the analysed contrast is most consistent with post-mortem lung; the reference handles this and no response surfaces it
"Distinguished the vitamin D responses" refers in the paper to a comparison between donor groups that this single contrast cannot test
The analysed contrast is unrecorded and may be an in vitro hepatocyte model; absence of TGFB1 induction may then be expected rather than divergent
The reference's suggestion that the shared targets are most likely chemokine/GPCR signalling genes is not shown in the evidence
The Contradicts relation rests on non-significant trends while HV-016 treats non-significant trends as Qualifies; bulk-tissue composition is an alternative explanation
TIMP4 logFC 0.00 with adj p 1.0 may be a placeholder for an unmeasured gene
BIRC5 is p53-repressed and cell-cycle-linked; this may limit how strongly the step supports the p53-independent arm
The Supports relation depends on cortisone availability and H6PD-dependent reductase activity; neither is measured
"Independently confirm" overstates how separate the MF evidence is from Step 1
